name: Venkateshwara Tent House
tagline: Event rentals, planning and catering in Bangalore
address: #14 G, SBM Road, Uttarahalli Main Road, KSRTC Layout, Chikkalasandra, opposite Kaggis Bakery
about:
Venkateshwara Tent House rents tents, chairs, sofas and decoration for events across Bengaluru. Vikram has run the business since 2016.
Every rental includes delivery, setup and pickup. We also rent mattresses, lights, sound systems, projectors, camping tents, and catering utensils and serving dishes.
We plan and manage full events, with stage, flower and mandap decoration, for weddings, engagements, birthdays, corporate events, seminars, political rallies and cultural functions. We also do catering.
Email: venkateshwaratenthouse07@gmail.com. Rated 4.8 on Justdial from 579 ratings.
